plain_statement: It is false that: The edge function of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges). Take the nine inputs, the wire AND(x_4, x_6), then at most 13 gates of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT, then one last OR gate reading at most two of all those wires. The last gate does not compute the function.
